title: The Ethical Risks of Analyzing Crisis Events on Social Media with Machine Learning
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper does not conduct or describe a benchmark related to faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on broader ethical risks like privacy, misinformation, and algorithmic biases related to race, gender, and socioeconomic status in the context of crisis informatics.
